messages:
deploy-bot: starting rollout rl-2026-04-02-09 canary=5% -> scheduled ramp to 30% in 10m
anya: running postdeploy smoke suite — seeing synth fuzz check failures on /summarize outputs in eu-west :thinking:
sam: what kind of failures? diffs vs baseline or 5xxs?
anya: not 5xxs; outputs returned 200 but semantic diff score against baseline jumped (rouge-1 drop ~0.12), some summaries truncating early
jessica: release notes said tokenizer patch + model micro-bump (variant=v4.5.1). Could be tokenization change affecting length heuristics
sam: hmm. latency/throughput OK? any tail errors?
anya: p95 same, p99 stable, it's the content check in synth smoke (we run small eval prompts).
triage-bot: INC-2026-089 created - postdeploy semantic drift detected by smoke fuzz tests
sam: proposal: pause ramp and pin /summarize route to previous model variant v4.5.0 while we confirm if tokenizer change caused regression
anya: +1 pause and pin. We prefer content correctness over rapid ramp
jessica: agree. We'll need to capture example diffs for the model team; I'll dump sample pairs to the ticket
sam: pin API sample:
```
POST /admin/routing/pin
{"route":"/summarize","variant":"v4.5.0"}
```
sam: applied pin at 4924681392 (actor: sam) :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: routing pin applied to /summarize -> v4.5.0
ops-bot: smoke-probe (post-pin) -> functional checks ok, semantic fuzz pass on sample set status=ok
anya: synth fuzz scores back in expected range after pin — looks like tokenizer bump changed token boundaries and summary length heuristics
jessica: filed follow-up RFC-2026-142 to evaluate tokenizer compatibility tests, added samples and diffs to ticket for model infra
triage-bot: INC-2026-089 marked monitoring; awaiting further analysis
sam: adding note to changelog: "pinned /summarize to v4.5.0 due to postdeploy semantic drift detected by synth fuzz checks after tokenizer bump in v4.5.1; under investigation (RFC-2026-142)"
anya: retrospective item: add a tiny semantic-sanity synthetic to preflight that compares key metrics (rouge/bleu/length) for critical routes when tokenizer or model bumps are included in a release
jessica: also recommend adding a minimal diff-snapshot to model rollout pipeline so we can auto-block if regression > threshold
sam: will keep canary at 5% for a 30m stability window, if stable we'll resume rollout with either revert or a compatibility patch
anya: thanks all — keeping this thread open until we have root-cause and plan
triage-bot: locknote: do not close incident until RFC created and sample diffs uploaded
